Presenting TU ROOTHA DIL TOOTA FULL VIDEO SONG from YAARANA movie starring Amitabh Bachchan, Amjad Khan, Neetu Singh, Kader Khan, Tanuja, Ranjeet & Jeevan in lead roles, released on Jan 10, 1981. The song is sung by Kishore Kumar and music is given by Rajesh Roshan, music is available exclusively on Gaane Sune Ansune.
Song: TU ROOTHA DIL TOOTA
Singer: KISHORE KUMAR
Music Director: RAJESH ROSHAN
Lyricist: ANJAAN
